Led by an Expert Who Built Sri Lanka’s First Geographically Connected Army Hospital Information System
DocPP is built on the expertise of a retired healthcare IT professional who developed and successfully implemented the Army Hospital Information System. With over a decade of hands-on experience in designing and deploying clinical management systems tailored for Sri Lankan healthcare professionals, he has shaped DocPP into a reliable, practical, and future-ready solution. Watch the short video below to see how the Army Hospital Information System inspired the foundation of DocPP.
DocPP Clinical Management System — Live Demonstration for Sri Lankan Doctors
This recorded live demonstration (2022) showcases DocPP’s core features — from patient registration and prescription management to appointment scheduling and reporting — giving doctors and clinic administrators a clear view of how to integrate DocPP into their own practice.
Since then, DocPP has continued to evolve, introducing advanced modules such as AI-powered Patient Overview and intelligent workflow enhancements — while keeping the same reliability and simplicity demonstrated here.

Questions & Answers
Quick Answers to Common Questions
- There are free EMR systems. But you don’t offer a free one. Why?It’s true that some providers claim to offer free EMR (Electronic Medical Records) systems. However, most of these solutions are either unsafe, unstable, or unsustainable. Many so-called free EMR platforms: 
  - 
Collect and analyse your patient data without proper security.
  - 
Lack strong privacy protection or compliance with healthcare data standards.
  - 
Shut down after a few months, causing you to lose all patient records and clinical history.
 Running a reliable EMR software solution requires continuous development, hosting, and security maintenance. If a provider isn’t charging, they are often earning ROI from your data or cutting corners. At DocPP, we prioritise data security, system reliability, and long-term sustainability—that’s why we don’t offer a “free forever” plan.

Experience the full features of our EMR platform risk-free.
